decision.explanation: All four positions are explicitly stated in the provided sources and correspond directly to Carlos Enciso. Document d1 supports 'Member of the Chamber of Deputies of Uruguay' (D1S3), while document d2 supports the other three roles: 'sub-prefect of Saverne' (D2S10), 'cultural attaché at the Uruguayan Embassy in Paris' (D2S8), and 'researcher at the Uruguayan Ministry of Foreign Affairs' (D2S6). Each is attributed to the same referent (Carlos Enciso) and is supported by direct textual evidence. There is no indication of conflicting claims about the same role, so all four are retained.
